We tracked down suspicious funds from Haiti hidden in Quebec

Hundreds of millions of dollars disappeared from Haiti under the dictatorship of Jean-Claude Duvalier. Nearly forty years later, what has become of this money? Will Haitians ever see any of it again?

Guests: Frédéric Zalac, Radio-Canada journalist; Sylvain Besson, Tamedia journalist

Presented by: Dominique Laresche

TV5MONDE is mobilising its teams to cover the opening ceremony of the 20th Francophonie Summit in Phnom Penh. Attended by OIF heads of state and government, the event marks the official launch of proceedings. The chosen theme: reinvesting in peace for shared prosperity and lasting stability.

Destination Cambodia

On the occasion of the 2026 Francophonie Summit, an exceptional journey into the heart of Cambodia's vibrant, diverse French-speaking community, deeply rooted in the country's history. From Phnom Penh to Battambang, via Kampot and the temples of Angkor, 90 exclusive minutes exploring French-speaking Cambodia, past and present.

Presented by: Ivan Kabacoff

An actor on stage and screen and a great art lover, François-Xavier Demaison is starring in the play "Laponie". Inès Longevial, now a leading contemporary artist, rose to fame on social media before winning over galleries around the world.

Guests: François-Xavier Demaison, comedian and actor; Inès Longevial, painter

Presented by: Ali Baddou. With contributions from Nathalie Lesage, Margaux Beytout, Sylvestre Defontaine, Reza Pounewatchy

Free trade: meat under fire

The Swiss Parliament has approved the trade agreement between Switzerland and Mercosur. While Bern has released EUR550,000 to appease angry farmers, many cattle farmers are wondering whether they will be able to compete with the production costs of Argentinian meat.

Guests: Léandre Duggan, RTS journalist; Thierry Pouch, chief economist at the Chambre d'agriculture France, editor-in-chief of « Paysans & Société »

Presented by: Dominique Laresche

Destination Gaspésie

Welcome to the end of the world, to one of Quebec's most magnificent and authentic regions: Gaspésie. A land of fishermen, Indigenous peoples, Acadians and explorers, and a cradle of North American Francophonie. A journey combining spectacular nature and heritage, with Gaspesians as generous as the land they call home.

Presented by: Nathalie Lesage
